description:
Get the current account profile

Returns the account that the presented API key belongs to, which is the simplest way to confirm a key is valid and to discover the user id every other endpoint scopes to. `resellerId` is set when this account is a customer of a reseller, and `ownResellerId` is set when the account operates a reseller itself; both are null for a plain direct account. `avatarUrl` is always null: no avatar image is stored for API consumers, and the field exists only so the shape stays stable. `billingAddress` is the address on your invoices as `PUT /users/me/billing-address` saves it, null while none is saved. The profile is returned as a bare object, not wrapped in a `data` envelope.
name: get_my_account
title: Get the current account profile
